ko.executive_summary: Samsung increases Exynos 2700 output to support non-memory semiconductor rebound in South Korea. Qualcomm officially denies overheating reports for Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 ahead of Snapdragon 27 launch.

implications.text: Increased Exynos output signals Samsung's strategic push beyond memory chips toward application processors for broader market competitiveness.
Official denial of overheating issues aims to maintain customer confidence and market reputation as S27 launch approaches.

ko.counterpoint: Exynos historical performance challenges and market share losses to Snapdragon may limit impact of production increases.
